article_framing_rejections.headline: St. Lucie County sheriff's deputy fired over social media post mocking agency standards

lead_independence.headline: St. Lucie County sheriff's deputy fired over social media post mocking agency standards
lead_independence.lead: Deputy Tina Speicker was fired on June 12, 2026, after an Internal Affairs investigation found she created a social media post that mocked Sheriff Richard Del Toro's 'Standards of Performance.' On Oct. 10, 2025, Sheriff Del Toro was made aware of a Facebook post on Speicker's personal account featuring an image titled 'Standards of Power.' The report says the image closely resembled Del Toro's 'Standards of Performance,' which was introduced after he was sworn into office and outlined eight performance expectations for employees, agency divisions and the Sheriff's Office's core values.
